purpose: Reuse exact previous-image samples and gradients within each CPU LK point/level iteration loop.

contract.math: Retain validation, in-bounds decisions on both frames in every iteration, sampling formulas, row-major accumulation and update/convergence order. Lazily save only previous-image center/gradient f64 values when a sample is first admitted. Radius at most 5 and more than one configured iteration use the bounded cache; other calls retain the original expressions. Keep the pyramid pair, custom conversions, public APIs, dependencies, core and explicit transfers unchanged.
contract.ownership: One call-local fixed optional array of at most 121 slots, each three f64 values, for one point/level. No heap allocation or cache across calls. Assert the array representation is at most 4096 bytes on each tested target; this excludes other stack/frame/runtime memory and is not an RSS guarantee.
contract.verification: Freeze the complete parent LK module, excluding its tests, before implementation. Compare exact coordinate/status/error bits across public one-way and robust APIs, dtypes, boundaries, changing support, strided images, options and non-finite inputs. Retain independent parent camera executable and actual parent/candidate WASM comparisons. In-process frozen-parent versus candidate measurements retain both stationary and translated cases, all samples and adverse rows.
contract.preservation: Preserve all prior camera/renderer files, isolated Cargo target, 493 scientific JSON, 42 frozen native artifacts, room/reference outputs, both existing raw WASM files and resolved lock. Build only feature-scoped vision/web code in a fresh isolated E-drive target with locked/offline installed toolchains. No sensor/model/SDK/browser/toolchain acquisition or sensor payload copies.

resources.strategy: Fresh isolated Cargo outputs, no compiler-output hardlinks. Reuse hash-checked vendor and parent package files. Sample bytes and preserve old artifacts before/after each owned command. Retry only transient vanished entries in the owned live Cargo subtree, at most three complete snapshots; fail on unrelated/persistent errors.

benchmark.options: radius 5, levels 3, 30 iterations, epsilon 0.001, minimum eigenvalue 0.0001, round-trip threshold 1
benchmark.comparison: Frozen complete parent LK module with its existing shared-pyramid robust call graph versus candidate robust API, interleaved in the same native release process. Compare full coordinate/status/error bit snapshots outside timing. Two fresh process surveys, fixed shape/point/motion order, all samples and adverse rows retained. Affinity/frequency, other host load and allocation effects are uncontrolled; no physical-phone, GPU or end-to-end claim.

remaining_80_percent: Measured calibration/timing and independent motion, full-room accuracy, qualifying physical Linux hardware and integrated operational acceptance remain open.
